verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a payments platform that ships SDKs, embeddable components, and a JS bundle, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents such an opt-out. The data-ownership and export statement is a related but different privacy feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
